entities.summary: Mathias Tulyoongeleni Hamunyela is a Namibian professional boxer. As an amateur he competed in the men's light flyweight event at the 2016 Summer Olympics where he defeated Azerbaijan's Rufat Huseynov in the first round but lost to Kazakhstan's Birzhan Zhakypov in the second round.
